differences.what: the tower's lights, courses and drum (T-3729's build, on this camera): the south-east lights of all three stages at x 1745-1790 px, the east lights at the drum's right edge (x 1830-1845), the cone's eave course at y 796-808 and the drum's edge at x 1850 stand where the print draws them, within about 10 px (0.2 m)

the tower's cone: built at 2.0 rise to 1 run its apex stood about 60 px (1.2 m) over the point the print's cone edges converge on behind the lamp head (about y 615); now 1.6 to 1, its apex within about 0.2 m of it

the south flank's front part: laid in K03 buff brick where the print shows the front's rock-faced coursed ashlar carried round onto it (x 1460-1585 px, its second-storey light at x 1490-1530, which the build's south light matches in place); now laid in the same rock-faced stone its whole length (stone_front.flanks south), as sheet 35's blue along the whole south edge reads
the second-storey light on the front's south bay (x 1600-1620 px, y 930-1010) and the south flank's second-storey light (x 1490-1530): in place within about 15 px

the stack: the print's one visible stack stands just south of the tower's cone, short and broad (x 1598-1645 px, top about y 675); T-3729's stood at u 13.0, far behind. Now on the side-gabled roof's ridge at u 17.93, v 9.0, about 1.0 m along it and 0.75 m over it, where the print draws it within about 15 px

the tone of the stone: the tower and front print mid-grey, as dark as 2140's brick, where the render's Lemont is pale; the print is monochrome under an overcast sky and the Van Osdel print shows the same stone near white in sun, so its colour is not shown

the iron railing on its curb along the street and the pier at the lot line (x about 1770 px, behind the lamp post): in place; the railing's pattern and the pier's cap are the kits', at the print's resolution behind the lamp
the flanks behind the front, the rear and the rear range: hidden by 2140

the roof over the front: T-3729 carried the front up as a steep street gable to 15.4 m over a hip; neither picture shows any gable on the street front. Now the front block is side-gabled (K01's gable roof): the south flank carried up as a gable in the front's rock-faced stone, its rake from the front's south eave at 52 degrees, and the ridge along the avenue 4.0 m behind the front at about 13.9 m. On the Chicagology camera the rake lies along the print's (x 1482-1590 px, y 740-877 px) within about 10 px (0.2 m) and the ridge along its cresting (y 670 px at x 1465, 705 px at x 1550) within about 5 px; the T-3730 first pass's reading (apex 2.3 m back at 13.5 m) put the rake about 40 px off

the columned porch across the front's south end (posts and an entablature at about the principal floor's head, the Chicagology print's x 1460-1680 px, y 1030-1200, wrapping onto the south flank's first metre; the Van Osdel print's x 546-575, y 399-440): not built, the door stands bare at the top of the stoop (L-k01-2130-murdoch-3729: no K01 part stands a recessed corner porch under a front)
the attic light in the south gable (x 1460-1493 px, y 787-867 px, its sill about the front's eave): not built, the gable is a K05 coped parapet and carries no light (L-k01-2130-murdoch-3730)

the front's north part beside the tower: both pictures carry it up as wall to about the cone's eave (about 11.2 m) under an eave of its own, which runs on from the cone's eave course to the left of the drum (the Chicagology print's x 1600-1673 px, y 790-880 px, a valley rising from the front's eave near x 1657, y 880 to the ridge near x 1550, y 707; the Van Osdel print's pale wall left of the drum up to y 280 px), where the build's street slope comes down to the 8.8 m eave there: about 1.5 m of wall and eave a visitor would see as slate (L-k01-2130-murdoch-3730)

the south gable's rake: the print shows a plain verge, the slate run just past the wall's top; the build carries K05's coping up the rake about 0.1 m over the slate. And the iron cresting along the ridge (y 660-690 px, a row of small finials): not built, thin ironwork under 0.3 m

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
